title: A11yGate repository config (.a11ygate.yml)
description: Setup choices for A11yGate. `a11ygate doctor` reads `engines` and the model-fix opt-in reads `modelFixes`; the other keys record the choices that the explicit flags in your CI file apply (shown as x-cli). Automated testing only. Not a WCAG audit, certification or legal advice.

url.description: Start URL of a site you own or are authorized to test. HTTP(S) only, no credentials in the URL.

crawl.description: 0 = start URL only; 1-20 = same-origin crawl page limit.

maxPages.description: Explicit crawl page budget overriding crawl; record alongside --max-pages in CI.

maxDepth.description: Maximum link depth; start URL and sitemap seeds have depth zero.

timeoutMs.description: Whole-page navigation and analysis deadline in milliseconds.

concurrency.description: Maximum active browser pages; global delay still spaces starts and retries.

sitemap.description: Same-origin sitemap URL or path supplied through --sitemap.

include.description: Include globs supplied through repeatable --include flags.

exclude.description: Exclude globs supplied through repeatable --exclude flags; exclusions win.

ignoreRobots.description: Record the explicit --ignore-robots opt-out for an authorized scan; default false.

failOn.description: Lowest impact that fails the scan; none never fails on findings.

engines.description: Scan engines. axe is bundled with the scan peers; htmlcs, ibm and lighthouse need their optional peer packages.

modelFixes.description: Repository opt-in for experimental model-assisted fixes. Off unless exactly true; a flag cannot override false.

formats.description: Extra report formats written to outDir.

delayMs.description: Polite delay between crawled pages, in milliseconds.

auth.description: Authenticated scans. Never put credentials here: name environment variables instead.

storageState.description: Playwright storage-state JSON file (keep it out of version control).

loginScript.description: Login script run in an isolated worker before scanning.

cookieEnv.description: Cookies as NAME=ENV_VAR_NAME; the value is read from the environment.

headerEnv.description: Headers as NAME=ENV_VAR_NAME; the value is read from the environment.
